user.title: Snapserver Control
user.description: This integration creates entities to control your Snapserver addon's audio quality settings and to monitor which Snapcast clients are connected. The Snapserver addon must be installed and running.

data_description.rpc_host: Leave this at 127.0.0.1 unless Home Assistant cannot reach the addon over localhost.
data_description.rpc_port: Snapserver's JSON-RPC control port. The addon uses 1705.

ma.title: Music Assistant connection
ma.description: The stream sample format is owned by Music Assistant, so changing it needs MA's API. This requires a long-lived token for an ADMIN user: open the Music Assistant web UI, go to Settings, open your admin user's profile and create a long-lived token there. The token Home Assistant received automatically is not sufficient (it cannot write provider settings). You can skip this and add it later via the integration's options; until then the Sample Format entity stays unavailable.

data.configure_ma_later: Skip for now (Sample Format entity will be unavailable)

data_description.ma_url: Usually http://127.0.0.1:8095 when Music Assistant runs as an addon on this machine. Must end in :8095 (the main web server) — not :8094, which is the Home Assistant-Ingress port and cannot accept any token.
data_description.ma_token: Created in the Music Assistant web UI under your admin user's profile.

error.addon_not_found: Snapserver addon not found. Please install the Snapserver addon first.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Snapserver's control port. Check that the addon is running, then try again.
error.cannot_connect_ma: Could not reach Music Assistant or find its Snapcast provider: {error}
error.ma_url_is_ingress_port: That URL is Music Assistant's Home Assistant-Ingress port, which cannot accept a token no matter which one you use. Change the port to {port} (the main Music Assistant web server) and try again.
error.invalid_ma_token: Music Assistant rejected the token, or no token was entered. Paste a long-lived token for an admin user (or check the skip option).
error.ma_token_not_admin: The token works but lacks admin rights, so it cannot change provider settings. Create the long-lived token under an ADMIN user in the Music Assistant web UI.

init.title: Snapserver Control
init.description: Where to reach Snapserver's JSON-RPC control socket, and optionally Music Assistant (URL plus an ADMIN long-lived token, created in the MA web UI under your admin user's profile) for the Sample Format entity. Saving reconnects the integration.

data_description.ma_token: Leave both MA fields empty to disable the Sample Format entity.

set_codec.name: Set Audio Codec
set_codec.description: Change the Snapserver audio codec. This restarts the server and briefly disconnects all clients.

codec.name: Codec
codec.description: Audio codec: flac (lossless), pcm (uncompressed), opus, or vorbis

set_sampleformat.name: Set Sample Format
set_sampleformat.description: Change Music Assistant's Snapcast stream format (rate:bits:channels). This reloads the MA Snapcast provider (about 10 seconds of audio interruption) and does NOT restart the Snapserver addon. Requires the Music Assistant connection to be configured.

sampleformat.name: Sample Format
sampleformat.description: Sample format as rate:bits:channels (16-bit only, e.g. 48000:16:2)

set_buffer.name: Set Buffer Size
set_buffer.description: Change the Snapserver buffer size in milliseconds. This restarts the server and briefly disconnects all clients.

delete_client.name: Delete Client
delete_client.description: Permanently remove a client from Snapserver. Use this for a client that will never reconnect, such as a machine whose network adapter changed, so it stops showing as disconnected.

client_id.name: Client ID
client_id.description: The client's ID, which is its MAC address (see the client_id attribute on its connectivity sensor).
